doubts.claim_under_doubt: reviewed_commit is the HEAD the reviewer actually saw
doubts.disproof_attempt: The command rev-parsed HEAD at record time, so a fix committed before recording would be credited as reviewed.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Capture the SHA before the spawn. FIXED in the three command references.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: verdict: pass means the reviewer passed the change
doubts.disproof_attempt: --verdict is a free flag and attest() never read findings, so an unfixed high would attest.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: attest() refuses a pass row carrying a high/critical finding. FIXED.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the rows attest() reads are the rows that get merged
doubts.disproof_attempt: read_record read the working tree, so an uncommitted row could attest a tree that never carries it.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Read reviews.json from the head commit. FIXED.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: nothing outside .shipwright/ and CHANGELOG-unreleased.d/ can change the reviewed behaviour
doubts.disproof_attempt: Scripts, bloat exceptions and the traceability manifest live under .shipwright/ and feed gates.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Treat executable suffixes, bloat-exception and test-traceability.json as code. FIXED.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: a small diff that fires 3f-bis still gets an independent Stage-3 judgement
doubts.disproof_attempt: doubt not_applicable is accepted on a small risk-flagged diff.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Rebutted: 3f-bis's own path already lets doubt be not_applicable on a small diff.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the salvage hook writes into the one right unit worktree
doubts.disproof_attempt: The first matching worktree won even when several held the run id.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Refuse when more than one distinct worktree holds it. FIXED.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the attestation path is reachable in practice
doubts.disproof_attempt: A consolidating F6 would make reviewed_commit a non-ancestor; that fails closed.
